name: thread
description: Side threads that start from a short brief of the session (or a full copy), report back on demand, and can run as a sub-agent or on another coding CLI through your delegation lanes, plus a project board of tasks, ideas and milestones (summary, kanban, list, your own stages, a done gate) that can live in your repo to follow you across devices, wake the session when you answer on it, and open on your phone through a tunnel you turn on.
